name: Anna Zwoelf
original_name: アンナ • ツヴェルフ
source:
Hobbies: Kicking annoying men's jewels. 
Favorite Food: Pirozhki
Least Favorite Food: Spicy Food
Favorite Animal: Hamsters
Least Favorite Animal: Big Animals
Favorite Motto: Learn as long as you live.

A Russian first-year exchange student who came to Japan because she liked anime and manga at first sight. Due to her good looks, she is popular among her male peers— however, her poisonous tongue is known to make them all cry.
